explication: Claude Code Sub-Agent Collective is an experimental installer and runtime framework for Claude Code, providing TDD-oriented specialist agents, routing, handoffs, research support, and installation management. The main user-to-result flow is: a developer invokes the install command, the installer configures the project from templates, and the installed `/van` workflow routes a request through the task orchestrator to specialist agents, with tests-first implementation and delivery. The graph also preserves validation, dynamic agent management, and research metrics. Some template capabilities are documented in the README but their runtime wiring was not sampled, so those links are documented or left unasserted.
